items.title: Professional Summary
items.content:
Quantitative and detail-oriented finance student

Proven track record in Financial Modeling, Equity Research, and Valuation (DCF, Comps). Passionate about the intersection of macroeconomic trends and the New York capital markets, and looking to bring analytical skills to a fast-paced analyst role.

Technical Skills

Financial Modeling

  • DCF & LBO modeling
  • 3-statement integration
  • M&A accretion/dilution
  • Sensitivity and scenario analysis

Data & Analytics

  • Python (pandas, NumPy)
  • Bloomberg Terminal / FactSet
  • Advanced Excel (VBA, macros)
  • Tableau / Power BI

Professional Skills

  • CRM tools
  • Persuasive presentations
  • Decision making under pressure
  • Business writing

items.title: Projects
items.content:
Equity Research Report · January 2024

Objective: Determine whether a large-cap bank stock was undervalued.

Methodology: Built a 5-year Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model and a Comparable Company Analysis against a 10-firm peer group.

Result: Recommended a Buy with a 14% upside target, presented to the student investment club.

Algorithmic Trading Strategy (Python) · March 2024

Objective: Develop a mean-reversion strategy for S&P 500 ETFs.

Methodology: Backtested against 10 years of historical data and measured the Sharpe Ratio, Sortino Ratio, and Maximum Drawdown.

items.title: Professional Experience
items.content:
Summer Analyst · Meridian Bank, New York, NY

  • Supported the deal team on $50M+ in mid-market M&A transactions.
  • Automated weekly market update reports in Excel VBA, cutting manual entry time by 40%.
  • Performed due diligence on 5+ target companies, focusing on EBITDA adjustments and working capital trends.

Sales & Trading Intern · Hudson Ridge Capital, Brooklyn, NY

Rotated across the Fixed Income, Currencies, and Commodities (FICC) and Equity Derivatives desks.

  • Trade execution and support: Assisted senior traders with high-volume flow on books with daily notionals above $500M.
  • Quantitative analysis: Built a Python dashboard tracking volatility spreads between S&P 500 options and VIX futures, surfacing 3 actionable opportunities.
  • Market intelligence: Turned macroeconomic news and Federal Reserve commentary into daily “Morning Run” briefings.
  • Risk management: Monitored desk Value at Risk (VaR) and the Greeks (Delta, Gamma, Vega) to keep positions within risk limits.

items.title: Education & Certifications
items.content:
B.S. in Finance · Class of 2025

GPA: 3.8/4.0 · Honors: Dean’s List, Beta Gamma Sigma, Investment Club Sector Lead

  • Investment Analysis: Applied Modern Portfolio Theory and CAPM to optimize a mock $1M portfolio.
  • Corporate Finance: Capital structure optimization, WACC calculation, and dividend policy analysis.
  • Econometrics: Multiple regression on market volatility drivers in R and Python.

Professional Certifications

  • Bloomberg Market Concepts (BMC): 8+ hours of interactive training on the Terminal across Economics, Currencies, Fixed Income, and Equities.
  • CFA Investment Foundations: The investment chain, asset classes, regulation, and fiduciary responsibility.
  • Wall Street Prep, Financial Modeling & Valuation: 3-statement, DCF, and M&A accretion/dilution models built from real case studies.
